verdict.rationale: Belvo's asynchronous-workflow docs mention "real-time POST calls" that work on both single and recurrent links, which implies the developer can request fresh data from the institution on demand. The pack never states this as a refresh operation and never explains how it behaves. The weekly automatic refresh for recurrent links is a recurring schedule, not an on-demand trigger, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit on-demand refresh endpoint or explanation that POST calls re-fetch live data, documented refresh semantics (latency, limits, what gets updated, status and failure handling), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented

citations.quote: Asynchronous real-time POST calls (both single and recurrent links) Eliminate the risk of timeouts and improve your data flow.
